name: prose-author
description: Measured-voice drafting with a versioned style tuner. Keeps observed corpus evidence separate from scoped user preferences, supports discovery and controlled comparisons, and drafts without corpus access.

interface.shortDescription: Drafts from measured voice evidence plus versioned, scoped user preferences.
interface.longDescription: Renders a single-author corpus into immutable voice-profile/2 evidence, then layers versioned voice-preferences/1 decisions without rewriting the observations. prose-style-tune serves evidence in small discovery batches, translates direct or pairwise feedback into reviewable proposals, applies only explicitly accepted operations, compiles context-specific style specifications, and supports controlled A/B drafts. voice-draft receives only the request and compiled profile/specification, never the corpus or AI-tell catalog. Deterministic conformance and independent audits make deviations visible; they do not guarantee factual accuracy, quality, or resemblance.
defaultPrompt: This paragraph isn't working - rewrite it the way I write
Draft this section from my notes, in my voice
Write a new essay from this outline using my voice profile
Draft a reply for this reader and purpose in my voice
Show me three style traits at a time so I can decide what to lock or change
Compare two versions that differ only in how directly they open
